target.name: heat_related_mortality_rate_per_100000
target.description: Estimated daily rate of heat-related and heat-exacerbated mortality per 100,000 residents

scientific_limitations: Trained exclusively on synthetic calibration data; NOT official NCRB or IMD mortality data.
Produces state-level aggregated rates; MUST NOT be decomposed into district-level mortality.
Designed for early-warning and preparedness benchmarking, not individual clinical forecasting.
